exposure: Heterozygous de novo NALCN missense variant
outcome: Infantile hypotonia, psychomotor retardation, and characteristic facies 1 (IHPRF1)
Infantile hypotonia, psychomotor retardation, and characteristic facies 2 (IHPRF2)
Congenital contractures of the limbs and face, hypotonia, and developmental delay (CLIFAHDD)
cohort: The participants included 16 individuals with biallelic NALCN variants, 1 individual with a heterozygous de novo NALCN missense variant, and 12 individuals with biallelic UNC80 variants.
finding: The study provides a comprehensive overview of IHPRF1 and IHPRF2 phenotypes based on the largest cohort reported so far, revealing clinical variability especially among IHPRF1-affected individuals and differences between IHPRF1 and IHPRF2 phenotypes, and reports a novel autosomal-recessive missense NALCN variant leading to mild IHPRF1.
